home.resumo: I build back-end with Java and Spring Boot, with roots in electronics and embedded systems. At Stellantis, I validated automotive infotainment and connectivity. In my own projects, I build the whole path the data takes: from the CAN bus to the app screen.
home.resumo2: I like problems that require understanding the whole system before the first line of code. That was true debugging ECUs, where an intermittent failure only yields to method, and it is true in back-end work, where the wrong model charges you six months later. The timeline below starts with a quadruped robot in C++ and ends in full-stack platforms.
